request.initial_prompt: Rather the following is the account of it: the term _knowing_ has two senses; both the man who does not use his Knowledge, and he who does, are said to _know_: there will be a difference between a man's acting wrongly, who though possessed of Knowledge does not call it into operation, and his doing so who has it and actually exercises it: the latter is a strange case, but the mere having, if not exercising, presents no anomaly.

raw_segments.text: Rather the following is the account of it. The term knowing has two senses. Both the man who does not use his Knowledge, and he who does, are said to know. There will be a difference between a man's acting wrongly, who though possessed of Knowledge does not call it into operation, and his doing so who has it and actually exercises it. The latter is a strange case, but the mere having, if not exercising, presents no anomaly.
